summary: Monday's close extended a rates-and-dollar driven risk-off: real yields and the DXY pushed higher, squeezing growth names (QQQ sharply lagging defensive staples) and pressuring bitcoin toward multi-week lows with RSI near oversold. VIX held near its highest levels in months, and gold found no shelter as the firmer dollar and elevated real rates offset safe-haven demand.
tweet: Higher real yields and a stronger dollar drove Monday's risk-off, hammering tech and crypto while gold found no refuge either.
